narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think the angle at one o'clock is one degree, because the hour is one.
<bookmark mark='sliver'/>One degree is a tiny sliver, yet the gap from twelve to one is much wider.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The hour number counts gaps, and each gap holds many degrees.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, picture the hands at six o'clock. They lie in one straight line.
<bookmark mark='link'/>Six gaps of thirty degrees should then match a straight angle, and they do.
